top_signals.title: Aramco Headquarters Hit as Houthi Missiles Strike Saudi Arabia
top_signals.summary: Saudi Aramco’s executive headquarters in eastern Saudi Arabia was hit during a missile attack by Yemen’s Houthi militants on Tuesday, causing a fire in a part of the complex, the kingdom’s energy ministry said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: World-Beating China Bonds Can Overcome Paltry Yields, Funds Say
top_signals.summary: China’s world-beating bonds have dodged the selloff in global debt and some fund managers are positioning for further gains due to a strong yuan and a sluggish domestic economy.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Microsoft Patches More Than 1,400 Security Flaws
top_signals.summary: Microsoft today issued updates to fix more than 1,400 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and other software. Today's epic patch batch dwarfs September's record of nearly 1,000 fixes, which was already about ten times the normal monthly patch load from Redmond.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
